description: This file defines a CMake function 'map_issubsetof' that checks whether one map (subset) is a subset of another (superset) by iterating over keys and verifying key-value matches and hierarchical map relationships.

methods.name: map_issubsetof
methods.description: Checks if 'subset' is a subset of 'superset' by iterating over keys and verifying that each key-value pair in 'subset' exists in 'superset', including nested maps and lists.
